protocol.basis: Worst-case per-request reservation = context cap x input rate. Billing items: input tokens charged, output tokens free (provider docs: 'Jev charges for input tokens, and output tokens are free.'). Price snapshot 2026-10-07 from the model page: '$0.042 per million input tokens, $0 per million output tokens'; catalog Input Price 4.2e-8 USD/token, Output Price 0; verified against both published usage examples (492 x 4.2e-8 = 0.000020664; 476 x 4.2e-8 = 0.000019992). No non-token fee SKU exists for this model. QUESTIONS HAVE NO DOCUMENTED TOKEN COUNT, so the bound conservatively charges the full 32000-token context: 32000 x 4.2e-8 = 0.001344 USD/request; 6 requests = 0.008064 USD, inside the 0.25 ceiling. Scope: this six-state smoke batch, each request assembled locally under limits.maxInputBytes and profile.maxQuestions, so no request may exceed the cap. See scripts/r1-jev-real/cost-bound.ts.
